question: A woman is 4 times as old as her daughter. After 6 years, the woman's age will be three times that of her daughter. The sum of their present ages is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present Ratio (Woman : Daughter) = 4 : 1 (Difference = 3 units)

Ratio after 6 years = 3 : 1 (Difference = 2 units)

Equalize differences: Present (8 : 2) and Future (9 : 3). Ratio increase = 1 unit = 6 years.

Sum of present ratios = 8 + 2 = 10 units ⇒ 10 × 6 = 60 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 60 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea31c19cfc01c1df3babf49a76f35c3fb9d45e61d9937420c9891a6317638f25.png] 

**Given:** Woman age = 4 × Daughter age. After 6 years, Woman = 3 × Daughter.

Let the present age of the **daughter** be x and **woman** be 4x.

⇒ (4x + 6) = 3(x + 6)

⇒ 4x + 6 = 3x + 18

⇒ 4x − 3x = 18 − 6

⇒ x = 12 years

⇒ Woman present age = 4 × 12 = 48 years

⇒ Sum of present ages = 48 + 12 = 60 years

**∴ The correct answer is 60 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Difference Constant

The age difference between two people remains constant throughout their lives. Always multiply ratios to keep the difference parts equal.

Age Sum Property

When calculating the sum after 'n' years for 'k' people, the total sum increases by n × k years.</p
